retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, sepia-toned split layout featuring a seated male figure in 1970s attire with clean, bottom-aligned sans-serif typography.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist digital aesthetics are requested
serif or decorative typography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical split-screen composition where the left third is a dark, solid field and the right two-thirds contains a high-contrast, grainy sepia photograph of a man seated on a stool, wearing a textured blazer and slacks, with a thin vertical line separating the two sections.
coreVisualRelationships: Asymmetric balance between a dark void and a detailed photographic subject
High contrast between deep shadows and blown-out highlights in the sepia tone
Geometric tension created by the thin vertical dividing line
Textual grounding via bottom-left justified typography
coreInvariants: Sepia or monochromatic duotone color palette
Vertical split layout with a thin dividing rule

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Seated male figure occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, medium-full shot scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the high-contrast white of the shirt/hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the body to the hands, then shifts left to the typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy negative space on the left third, acting as a dark weight to balance the image.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber/black for shadows and the left panel.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm sepia/cream for highlights and skin tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast with a gritty, filmic grain.

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed within the dark negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with weight variation for secondary metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, mid-century modern aesthetic of the era.
Provides the necessary grit and structure for a vintage look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast sepia photograph of a man in a 70s blazer seated on a wooden stool against a textured wall. Split the image vertically: the left 30% should be a solid dark umber field separated by a thin white line.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of bold white sans-serif text in the bottom-left corner, justified left, using a font like Helvetica Bold.

verificationChecks: Is there a clear vertical split in the composition?
Is the text bold, white, and sans-serif?
Does the photograph have a high-grain, vintage texture?

adjustableVariables: Width of the left dark panel
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos in the top left
The specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for the thin vertical dividing line
Verify the text is bottom-left aligned
Ensure the sepia tone is consistent across the right panel
Confirm the subject's clothing reflects a 1970s aesthetic
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast vintage portrait with a minimalist split-screen layout and bold, bottom-aligned sans-serif typography.
